diagnosis: The endpoint cancels and discards a video transcoding job in BullMQ purely based on jobId from the URL path. It does not check if job.data.ownerId === req.user.id, allowing users to terminate video processing jobs belonging to other content creators.
exploit_request:
POST /api/media/transcode/job_vid_4k_99014/cancel HTTP/1.1
Host: studio.videoplatform.io
Authorization: Bearer <creator_jwt>
